name: MarqueeAll – Elementor Marquee Widgets: Image, Text, Post Grid, Testimonial & News Ticker 🌀
author: Aman Brar

sections.description:
MarqueeAll – Elementor Addon is the ultimate plugin to add smooth, continuous, auto-scrolling marquees and carousels to your Elementor pages.

Create engaging image sliders, text tickers, testimonial carousels, blog post marquees, and news tickers — all powered by simple drag-and-drop widgets inside Elementor.

Whether you’re a designer, blogger, agency, or eCommerce site owner, MarqueeAll helps you display dynamic content that keeps visitors scrolling and engaged.

🔥 Trusted by designers & developers to build interactive Elementor websites with dynamic scrolling animations.

🚀 Included Elementor Widgets

📚 Post Grid Marquee (New in 1.1.1)
Showcase your blog posts, portfolio, or custom post types in an auto-scrolling layout. Includes featured images, author name, date, excerpts, and read more links. Perfect for news sites, magazines, and portfolios.

🖼️ Image Marquee
Create smooth-scrolling image sliders with custom links, lightbox, lazy loading, and responsive spacing. Ideal for product showcases, client logos, and creative galleries.

📝 Text Marquee
Display scrolling text banners for announcements, offers, or promotions. Customize icons, typography, direction, and speed for maximum impact.

💬 Testimonial Marquee
Highlight customer feedback and ratings in a continuous scrolling testimonial carousel. Supports horizontal and vertical layouts.

📰 News Ticker
Display breaking news, offers, or blog headlines in a smooth scrolling ticker. Add custom icons, separators, and label text with full Elementor control.

🌟 Feature Highlights

⚡ Smooth, infinite scrolling animations
🧭 Horizontal & vertical scrolling directions
🔄 Reverse scroll + pause-on-hover
🎚️ Adjustable speed, spacing, and item size
🎨 Soft gradient mask for premium look
🖼️ Lightbox, lazy load & custom links for images
📱 Fully responsive and lightweight
💡 Native Elementor controls – no coding needed
🧩 Works with any theme built for Elementor

💎 Why MarqueeAll?

MarqueeAll helps your content stand out and move naturally — drawing attention without slowing your site down.

It’s not just a slider — it’s a motion-based content display system that improves engagement, reduces bounce rate, and boosts on-page interaction.

🚀 Built with minimal CSS/JS for faster load times
✅ Improves user engagement and time-on-page
🧠 SEO-optimized structure for posts, news & testimonials
🧩 Compatible with Elementor Free & Pro
📱 100% responsive for all devices
🔧 Developer-friendly & customizable

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/marqueeall or install directly from the WordPress Plugins directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open the Elementor editor and search for “MarqueeAll” or “Marquee”.
  4. Drag, drop, and customize the widget you want — image, text, testimonial, news, or post grid.
sections.faq:
Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it works with any theme that is compatible with Elementor.

Can I control the scrolling speed and direction?

Yes, you can adjust speed, direction (left, right, up, down), and spacing (gap) for every marquee widget.

How many items should I add for best performance?

For a smooth and seamless experience, we recommend 8–10 items per marquee. Adding too few items may break the continuous scrolling effect.

Can I add links or lightbox to images?

Yes, the Image Marquee supports custom links, media file lightbox, or no link as per your preference.

Does the plugin support lazy loading?

Yes, you can enable lazy loading to improve page speed and performance.

Can I pause the marquee on hover?

Absolutely! Each widget has a pause-on-hover option to allow users to read content easily.

screenshots.caption: MarqueeAll widgets – Example of Text, Image, Testimonials, News Ticker, and Post Grid marquees in action inside Elementor page builder.
Text Marquee widget – Smooth scrolling text with options to control direction (left, right, up, down), speed, and looping behavior.
Image Marquee widget – Create continuous scrolling image carousels with customizable direction, spacing, and animation settings.
Testimonials Marquee widget – Showcase client testimonials in an infinite marquee with adjustable scroll direction, transition effects, and autoplay controls.
News Ticker Marquee widget – Display latest news or updates in a ticker-style marquee with settings for scroll direction, delay, and pause on hover.

Post Grid Marquee widget – Display posts in a scrolling grid with featured image, author, date, excerpt, and read more link. Supports horizontal/vertical scrolling, reverse, pause-on-hover, speed, and gap settings.
